SELECT r.id AS riskCaseId,o.id AS orderId,o.order_no AS orderNo, c.id AS customerId,c.customer_no AS customerNo,COALESCE(c.display_name,c.nickname) AS customerName FROM crm_risk_case r LEFT JOIN crm_youzan_sync_issue yi ON yi.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND r.source_type='YOUZAN_SYNC_ISSUE' AND r.source_ref REGEXP '^[1-9][0-9]*$' AND yi.id=CAST(r.source_ref AS UNSIGNED) LEFT JOIN crm_youzan_event ye ON ye.tenant_id=yi.tenant_id AND ye.id=yi.event_id LEFT JOIN crm_youzan_order_map yom ON yom.tenant_id=ye.tenant_id AND yom.shop_id=ye.shop_id AND yom.external_order_no=ye.external_order_no LEFT JOIN crm_youzan_customer_link ycl ON ycl.tenant_id=ye.tenant_id AND ycl.shop_id=ye.shop_id AND ycl.external_customer_id=JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ye.payload_masked_json,'$.external_customer_id')) LEFT JOIN crm_refund rf ON rf.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND r.source_type='REFUND' AND r.source_ref REGEXP '^[1-9][0-9]*$' AND rf.id=CAST(r.source_ref AS UNSIGNED) LEFT JOIN crm_entitlement e ON e.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND r.source_type='ENTITLEMENT' AND r.source_ref REGEXP '^[1-9][0-9]*$' AND e.id=CAST(r.source_ref AS UNSIGNED) LEFT JOIN crm_order_item oi ON oi.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND oi.id=e.order_item_id LEFT JOIN crm_redemption rd ON rd.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND r.source_type='REDEMPTION' AND r.source_ref REGEXP '^[1-9][0-9]*$' AND rd.id=CAST(r.source_ref AS UNSIGNED) LEFT JOIN crm_order o ON o.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND ( (r.source_type='ORDER' AND r.source_ref REGEXP '^[1-9][0-9]*$' AND o.id=CAST(r.source_ref AS UNSIGNED)) OR (r.source_type='YOUZAN_SYNC_ISSUE' AND o.id=COALESCE(ye.order_id,yom.crm_order_id)) OR (r.source_type='REFUND' AND o.id=rf.order_id) OR (r.source_type='ENTITLEMENT' AND o.id=oi.order_id)) INNER JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND c.id=COALESCE(o.customer_id,ycl.customer_id,rf.customer_id,e.customer_id,rd.customer_id) WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.id IN #{riskCaseId} ORDER BY r.id
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_risk_case SET status=#{toStatus},owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, resolution=#{resolution,jdbcType=VARCHAR},resolved_at=#{resolvedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status=#{fromStatus}
